lesson_text: DD 12/28 overlay on STR_1566 (C19+L22 blend) confirmed L-801: wider DD thresholds preserve significantly more CAGR. DD 8/20 destroyed 7.2pp CAGR (20.1->12.9%), while DD 12/28 destroyed only 4.8pp (20.1->15.3%). Both achieve similar MDD compression (~32%). However, even the wider DD still pushes CAGR below 16% hurdle. For high-MDD strategies (47.6%), DD overlay alone cannot simultaneously pass both MDD<45% and CAGR>=16% when the base alpha is borderline. Consider: (1) DD 15/35 even wider, or (2) VT overlay instead of DD, or (3) accept the MDD and pursue via ensemble risk reduction.
core_reference: L-801 (DD 8/20 too aggressive), QEPM section 10 (overlay calibration), STR_1566/1567/1572 comparison series
